scanNote:
WORKBOOK 2-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (10-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '2' va 'Night and Day'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Sam had an exciting lifestyle when he was 30 years old. Unfortunately, things have changed. Use the prompts and make sentences about Sam's life then and now, as in the example.' SURAT: smokingdagi erkak va kechki libosdagi ayol (Sam va model). O'Y PUFAGI 'THEN': wear designer clothes, drive a sports car, be married to a model, live in a large house, eat at expensive restaurants, have a lot of friends, wake up very late. QUTI 'NOW': wear old clothes, ride a bicycle, be divorced, live in a small terraced house, cook his own food, not have many friends, wake up very early. Qiya namuna: 'Sam used to wear designer clothes when he was younger. Now he wears old clothes.'
10) 'Look at the prompts and ask and answer questions about Robert, as in the example.' IKKI USTUN: 'Robert, twenty years ago (6 years old)' (kubiklar bilan o'ynayotgan bola): have a pet fish, have a bicycle, go to bed early. 'Robert, today (26 years old)' (yosh erkak): have a pet dog, have a car, go to bed late. Qiya namuna: 'SA: Did Robert use to have a pet dog when he was six years old? SB: No, he didn't. He used to have a pet fish.'

O'NG USTUN:
11) 'Fill in the gaps with do(n't), does(n't) or did(n't).' 1 A: ...... you do the ironing yesterday? B: No, I ...... . I watched TV. 2 A: I ...... have breakfast in the mornings. B: I ......! I love breakfast! 3 A: ...... you start work at seven o'clock? B: No, I ...... . I start work at nine o'clock. 4 A: Mark ...... do his homework again, and his teacher was very angry. B: ...... she call his parents? 5 A: ...... Bill drink coffee? B: Yes, he ......, but he ...... drink tea.
12) 'Fill in the correct form of the verbs in brackets, then match the items to make full sentences.' 1 Jim usually ...... (play) football on Saturdays, but; 2 I usually ...... (drive) to work, but; 3 They usually ...... (visit) friends at weekends, but; 4 Mum usually ...... (cook) dinner, but; 5 Ann usually ...... (paint) pictures in her free time, but | a yesterday, I ...... (take) the bus. b last night, she ...... (read) a book. c last weekend she ...... (order) a pizza. d last Saturday, he ...... (go) to the beach. e last weekend, they ...... (stay) at home.
13) 'Correct the sentences as in the example.' 1 He catch (chizilgan) the bus to school every morning. ...catches... 2 She go to the beach last weekend. 3 They use to live near the city centre. 4 I am do the washing-up at the moment. 5 Pam didn't used to have short hair. 6 My father cooking dinner last night. 7 They are play basketball now. 8 David don't like watching TV.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '10'.

exercises.instructionEn: Sam had an exciting lifestyle when he was 30 years old. Unfortunately, things have changed. Use the prompts and make sentences about Sam's life then and now, as in the example. THEN: wear designer clothes, drive a sports car, be married to a model, live in a large house, eat at expensive restaurants, have a lot of friends, wake up very late. NOW: wear old clothes, ride a bicycle, be divorced, live in a small terraced house, cook his own food, not have many friends, wake up very early.
exercises.instructionUz: Sam 30 yoshida qiziqarli hayot kechirgan. Afsuski, hammasi o'zgargan. Ko'rsatmalar bilan Samning o'sha paytdagi va hozirgi hayoti haqida gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. O'ShANDA: dizayner kiyimlar kiyish, sport mashina haydash, modelga uylangan bo'lish, katta uyda yashash, qimmat restoranlarda ovqatlanish, ko'p do'stlarga ega bo'lish, juda kech uyg'onish. HOZIR: eski kiyimlar kiyish, velosipedda yurish, ajrashgan bo'lish, kichik qatorli uyda yashash, o'z ovqatini o'zi pishirish, ko'p do'sti yo'q, juda erta uyg'onish.
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO - O'TGAN ODAT
  (coursebook 15-bet qoidasi).

  QOLIP:
  THEN: Sam USED TO + fe'l ... when
        he was younger.
  NOW:  Now he + fe'l-S ... .


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Sam used to wear designer
   clothes when he was younger.
   Now he wears old clothes.'


⚠ 'USED TO' = ILGARI ... EDI
  (HOZIR YO'Q):

  'He used to drive a sports car' =
  ilgari sport mashina haydardi
  (hozir haydamaydi).

  ⚠ 'used to' dan keyin FE'L
  ODDIY ShAKLDA.
  ⚠ Hamma shaxs uchun bir xil:
  I/he/they used to.


⚠ 'NOW' - PRESENT SIMPLE:

  'Now he wears/rides/is/lives/
  cooks/doesn't have/wakes up'.


⚠ 'BE MARRIED TO':

  = ... ga uylangan/turmushga
  chiqqan ('with' EMAS!).
  'be divorced' = ajrashgan.


⚠ 'A TERRACED HOUSE':

  = qatorli uy (Britaniyada bir-
  biriga tutash uylar qatori).


⚠ 'HIS OWN FOOD':

  'own' = o'zining. 'cook his own
  food' = o'z ovqatini o'zi
  pishiradi.


⚠ 'DESIGNER CLOTHES':

  = mashhur dizayner kiyimlari
  (qimmat).
exercises.exampleEn: Sam used to wear designer clothes when he was younger. Now he wears old clothes.
exercises.exampleUz: Sam yoshroq paytida dizayner kiyimlar kiyardi. Hozir u eski kiyimlar kiyadi.
modelAnswers: Sam used to drive a sports car when he was younger. Now he rides a bicycle.
Sam used to be married to a model when he was younger. Now he is divorced.
Sam used to live in a large house when he was younger. Now he lives in a small terraced house.
Sam used to eat at expensive restaurants when he was younger. Now he cooks his own food.
Sam used to have a lot of friends when he was younger. Now he doesn't have many friends.
Sam used to wake up very late when he was younger. Now he wakes up very early.
modelAnswersUz: Sam yoshroq paytida sport mashina haydardi. Hozir u velosipedda yuradi.
Sam yoshroq paytida modelga uylangan edi. Hozir u ajrashgan.
Sam yoshroq paytida katta uyda yashardi. Hozir u kichik qatorli uyda yashaydi.
Sam yoshroq paytida qimmat restoranlarda ovqatlanardi. Hozir u o'z ovqatini o'zi pishiradi.
Samning yoshroq paytida ko'p do'stlari bor edi. Hozir uning ko'p do'sti yo'q.
Sam yoshroq paytida juda kech uyg'onardi. Hozir u juda erta uyg'onadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the prompts and ask and answer questions about Robert, as in the example. Robert, twenty years ago (6 years old): have a pet fish, have a bicycle, go to bed early. Robert, today (26 years old): have a pet dog, have a car, go to bed late.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarga qarang va Robert haqida savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. Robert, yigirma yil oldin (6 yosh): baliq boqish, velosipedga ega bo'lish, erta uxlash. Robert, bugun (26 yosh): it boqish, mashinaga ega bo'lish, kech uxlash.
exercises.explanationUz:
'USED TO' - SO'ROQ va INKOR.

  SO'ROQ: DID + ega + USE TO + fe'l?
    'Did Robert use to have a dog?'
    ⚠ 'use' - 'd' SIZ ('did' bor)!

  INKOR: didn't use to
  QISQA JAVOB: No, he didn't. /
    Yes, he did.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did Robert use to have a pet
      dog when he was six years old?
  SB: No, he didn't. He used to
      have a pet fish.

  ⚠ Savol HOZIRGI narsa haqida
  (dog/car/bed late) → javob 'No' +
  ILGARIGI narsa (fish/bicycle/
  early).


⚠ 'A PET':

  = uy hayvoni. 'a pet fish' =
  akvarium balig'i.

items.question: Did Robert use to have a pet dog when he was six years old?
items.answer: No, he didn't. He used to have a pet fish.
items.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. So'roqda 'use to' ('d' siz), javobda 'used to'.

items.question: Did Robert use to have a car when he was six years old?
items.answer: No, he didn't. He used to have a bicycle.

items.question: Did Robert use to go to bed late when he was six years old?
items.answer: No, he didn't. He used to go to bed early.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with do(n't), does(n't) or did(n't).
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni do(n't), does(n't) yoki did(n't) bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO / DOES / DID - YORDAMChI
  FE'LLAR.

  DO/DON'T   - present, I/you/we/
               they
  DOES/DOESN'T - present, he/she/it
  DID/DIDN'T - PAST, hamma shaxs


⚠ KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  1 'yesterday' → DID / didn't
  2 'in the mornings' (odat), 'I' →
    DON'T / DO
  3 'start work at seven' (odat),
    'you' → DO / don't
  4 'his teacher WAS angry' (o'tgan)
    → DIDN'T / Did
  5 'Bill' (he), odat → DOES / does /
    doesn't


⚠ 2-DIALOG - 'I DO!':

  'I don't have breakfast.' -
  'I DO!' = Men esa qilaman!
  (qarama-qarshilik, urg'u bilan).


⚠ QISQA JAVOBDA FE'L
  TAKRORLANMAYDI:

  'Yes, he does' ('Yes, he does
  drink' EMAS).

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shaklini qo'ying, so'ng bandlarni moslab to'liq gaplar tuzing. 1 Jim usually (play) football on Saturdays, but 2 I usually (drive) to work, but 3 They usually (visit) friends at weekends, but 4 Mum usually (cook) dinner, but 5 Ann usually (paint) pictures in her free time, but | a yesterday, I (take) the bus. b last night, she (read) a book. c last weekend she (order) a pizza. d last Saturday, he (go) to the beach. e last weekend, they (stay) at home.
exercises.explanationUz:
USUALLY (present simple) vs
  LAST ... / YESTERDAY (past
  simple).

  ChAP: usually → PRESENT:
    plays, drive, visit, cooks,
    paints
  O'NG: yesterday/last ... → PAST:
    took, read, ordered, went,
    stayed


⚠ MOSLASh - EGAGA QARANG:

  1 Jim (he) → d 'he went'
  2 I → a 'I took'
  3 They → e 'they stayed'
  4 Mum (she) → c 'she ordered'
  5 Ann (she) → b 'she read'
  ⚠ 4 va 5 ikkalasi 'she' - MA'NOGA
  qarang: Mum + ovqat → pizza;
  Ann + rasm → kitob.


⚠ NOQONUNIY FE'LLAR:

  take → TOOK
  read → READ /red/ (imlo bir xil,
    talaffuz boshqa!)
  go → WENT


⚠ QONUNIY: -ED:

  order → ordered, stay → stayed.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the sentences as in the example. Example: He catch the bus to school every morning. - catches
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni namunadagidek tuzating. Namuna: He catch the bus to school every morning. - catches
exercises.explanationUz:
XATOLARNI TUZATISh - 2-UNIT
  GRAMMATIKASI JAMLANMASI.

  1 every morning → present, he →
    catchES
  2 last weekend → PAST → went
  3 'use to' tasdiqda → USED to
  4 at the moment → continuous →
    am doING
  5 'didn't' dan keyin oddiy shakl
    → didn't USE to
  6 last night → PAST → cooked
  7 'are' + V-ING → are playING
  8 David = he → DOESN'T


⚠ 'USE TO' / 'USED TO':

  Tasdiq: USED to (d bilan)
  Inkor/so'roq: didn't/did ... USE
  to (d siz)


⚠ 'THE WASHING-UP':

  = idish yuvish. 'do the
  washing-up'.

patterns.formula: X used to + FE'L ... Now X + FE'L-s ...
patterns.exampleEn: Sam used to drive a sports car. Now he rides a bicycle.
patterns.exampleUz: Sam ilgari sport mashina haydardi. Hozir u velosipedda yuradi.

patterns.formula: Did X use to + FE'L? - No, he didn't. He used to ...
patterns.exampleEn: Did Robert use to have a car? - No, he didn't. He used to have a bicycle.
patterns.exampleUz: Robertning mashinasi bormidi? - Yo'q. Uning velosipedi bor edi.

patterns.formula: X usually + V-s, but yesterday/last ... X + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: I usually drive to work, but yesterday I took the bus.
patterns.exampleUz: Men odatda ishga mashinada boraman, lekin kecha avtobusga chiqdim.
